282146417.description:
Decatur Industries
Walnut Pipe Stand Carousel with Green Glass Humidor & 8 Estate Pipes
Walnut Wood, Textured Glass, Mixed Materials
Vintage smoking pipe carousel stand manufactured by Decatur Industries, featuring an 8-slot solid walnut rack paired with a textured green glass tobacco humidor jar and a wooden lid topped with an Oscar the Grouch figural finial. The lot includes eight collectible estate smoking pipes representing classic briar, metal frame, and mid-century synthetic styles.
Decatur Industries rotating walnut carousel with 8 pipe storage slots
Center textured green glass humidor jar with embossed maker mark on base and Oscar the Grouch lid handle
Lot of 8 vintage pipes including "The Smoke" marbled graphite pipe, a blue pipe, a gold-tone radiator pipe, and 5 carved briar pipes
Measures approximately 9.75 by 9.75 inches and 8.5 inches high
Condition:
Wood carousel and green glass jar are well preserved with light surface wear and no chips or cracks. Pipes are in pre-owned estate condition displaying smoke charring, bowl cake, and light stem tooth marks consistent with age and use.

280599462.description:
Natural Specimens
Polished Fluorite Heart and Raw Stone Collection
Mineral, Stone, and Seashell Set
Approx. 1" to 1.75" Dimensions
Unsigned
This eclectic collection features four distinct natural elements, headlined by a hand-polished green and blue fluorite heart. The fluorite exhibits characteristic translucency and internal crystalline structures typical of the mineral. Accompanying the heart is a weathered river stone with a smooth, water-worn texture, a raw mineral specimen with granular surface detail, and a naturally aged bivalve seashell with distinct ribbing and radial symmetry.
Polished fluorite heart displays vibrant shades of teal and forest green
Rough mineral specimen features crystalline inclusions and earthy tones
Natural bivalve seashell shows classic radial symmetry and weathered white finish
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. The fluorite heart is polished to a high gloss with minor internal fissures typical of the mineral. The raw stones and shell show natural textures, weathering, and geological characteristics consistent with their natural and geological origins.

282631977.description:
Collection of Rough Rock Salt Mineral Specimens Natural Pink Hues 2.6 lbs
This listing includes a collection of rough rock salt mineral specimens, often mistaken for rose quartz due to their pink hues. The stones are unpolished and vary in size and shape, exhibiting natural pink colors with occasional white and reddish-brown inclusions. The material is translucent with a crystalline structure. Some pieces show surface imperfections or mineral deposits typical of raw rock salt. These specimens are in their natural, unprocessed condition and are suitable for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, crafts, décor, or metaphysical uses. Lot weighs approximately 2.6 lbs
6 x 5 x 5 in
